subject: Mismatch on crate/pallet counts at offload — urgent routing decision
messages:
From: Logistics Solutions Inc <ops@logistics-sol.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Karen Liu <karen@chipboardco.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Delivery discrepancy at Crossdock B - manifest vs. physical count

Rishi —

We completed offload at Crossdock B (dock 4) at 08:45 local. The carrier's POD and the physical pallets on the floor don't match the manifest you signed off earlier today. Manifest v3 lists 10 pallets (10 crates), but our team counted 12 distinct pallets on the dock. Two pallets are partially labeled with a different PO: PO-7782 (looks like folding crates / sample packs), not PO-7810 (main booth freight).

Photos and the scanned manifest are attached (delivery_manifest_v3.pdf, offload_photos.zip). We also pulled the packing_list.csv from the carrier app — attached.

Immediate questions:
- Do you want us to proceed to the assigned advance warehouse (120 min drive) with all 12 pallets?
- OR segregate the two suspect pallets at Crossdock for separate verification (adds ~3 hours) and then move the rest?

We suspect a split pickup at the origin (two vendor crates got combined on one trailer). If you choose segregation, we can stage the two pallets in the yard and request vendor confirmation. If you choose full-move, we can crossdock and reconcile later but that risks mixing vendor samples with main booth assets.

Awaiting go-ahead.

—Miguel (Ops Lead)
Logistics Solutions Inc.
attachments: delivery_manifest_v3.pdf, offload_photos.zip, packing_list.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Logistics Solutions Inc <ops@logistics-sol.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery discrepancy at Crossdock B - manifest vs. physical count

Thanks Miguel —

Please do the following (we need to minimize risk to show build):
1) Segregate the two suspect pallets at the dock (lock/tape and label as "HOLD — Rishi 9/6") and take close-up photos of all labels & SKUs.
2) Move the remaining 10 pallets to Advance Warehouse #3 on the original routing — confirm estimated arrival.
3) If the held pallets are clearly vendor samples (packing slips show different PO), send an immediate written confirmation to Karen (cc'd) and to me; we'll instruct vendor how to reclaim or re-route.

Marissa / Tessa — can you confirm that Advance Warehouse #3 can accept 10 pallets arriving today and hold the 2 suspect pallets for up to 72 hours? If we need to redirect to a nearby offsite staging yard, say so now.

Also Miguel — if customs or bonded paperwork is involved for those two pallets, flag it separately. We don't want a customs hold to cascade.

I'll stand by for photos and the ETA for the main load.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Logistics Solutions Inc <ops@logistics-sol.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karen Liu <karen@chipboardco.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery discrepancy at Crossdock B - manifest vs. physical count

Rishi / team —

We followed your instructions. Actions taken: 
- Segregated pallets Y-11 and Y-12 (labels inconsistent) and sealed them with tamper tape. Photos attached (see offload_photos.zip folder: Y11_label.jpg, Y12_label.jpg).
- Main 10 pallets loaded onto local ministage truck, ETA to Advance Warehouse #3: 15:30 today (local).
- Held pallets remain at Crossdock B yard under our supervision. Vendor contact on the manifest is Karen Liu at Chipboard Co (cc).

On the paperwork side: packing_list.csv indicates the two suspect pallets have HS code 4202 which is usually fine, but the vendor description is 'promo samples — non-sellable' vs. 'booth components' on PO-7810. We haven't touched customs yet. If you want, we can run a quick HS-code recheck with customs broker; that would add ~2 hours.

Next steps possible now: broker check, or vendor confirmation. Which do you prefer?

—Miguel

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Logistics Solutions Inc <ops@logistics-sol.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery discrepancy at Crossdock B - manifest vs. physical count

All —

Thanks Miguel for the quick action and photos. Rishi — recommending we follow this path to keep the event schedule intact: 
- Accept the 10 pallets into Advance Warehouse #3 (confirm arrival window).
- Keep the two held pallets at Crossdock B and ask Karen to confirm ownership by EOD. If Karen confirms they're Chipboard Co promo samples, we will arrange immediate return shipment to vendor (overnight) at their cost.
- If Karen does NOT confirm by 18:00 PT, we escalate to on-site quarantine & vendor-notification (and prepare a temporary rework list so show team can substitute display pieces if needed).

I also asked Warehouse #3 about floor space — they have room but prefer notification of exact pallet dims/weights before unload. Miguel — can you send the pallet dimensions from the packing_list.csv in your next update?

I'll draft a short contingency memo for the show team so they know the 2 suspect crates won't be guaranteed for build tomorrow morning. Send me any language you want included.

—Marissa
Operations — Field Events
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Logistics Solutions Inc <ops@logistics-sol.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karen Liu <karen@chipboardco.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery discrepancy at Crossdock B - manifest vs. physical count

Quick update and decision: 

Karen confirmed this morning that Y-11/Y-12 are Chipboard Co promo crates (they were accidentally loaded on our trailer at origin). Karen will collect them from Crossdock B by 19:00 tonight (arranging local pick-up). Advance Warehouse #3 received the 10 main pallets at 15:28 yesterday and started inventory; no damages reported.

Marissa — please proceed with the contingency memo to the show build team saying two crates are outbound to vendor and not available for build. Miguel — please send the invoice for the extra on-site hold time and any additional yard fees to ops@redwood.com (we will route to finance).

Also flag insurance: if any items in the 10 accepted pallets are found damaged during set, we'll escalate to claims. For now, show timeline preserved. Closing this thread unless new issues surface.

Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

Rishi
Head of Field Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference
